summary: George Russell converted his pole position into victory at Baku, repelling Max Verstappen's late charge through two safety car restarts to secure Mercedes' second win of the season. Russell reflected on his flawless weekend as "the most dominant I've had in my career," a stark turnaround from what he described as a recent tough period. The result narrows the championship gap as Kimi Antonelli, who crashed in qualifying, struggles to recover ground in the standings.
